widgets_values:
Original 1990s shonen battle-anime arcade interface illustration: bold brush ink, hard-edged cel shadows, explosive radial speed lines, hand-painted energy clouds, deep midnight blue and black, vivid gold, electric cyan and hot magenta. Dramatic heroic tournament atmosphere and strong negative space for readable game UI. Original typography and emblems; no copied franchise characters, symbols or logos.
A square 3x3 anime combat effects atlas, exactly nine equally sized cells row-major, one isolated effect in each cell: 1. hit, 2. block, 3. projectile, 4. dust, 5. ko, 6. powerup, 7. dash, 8. launch, 9. spark. Orange, yellow, cream, magenta and cyan effects only. Projectile travels RIGHT. No characters. All effects fit their cell with 12% empty padding, equal visual scale. No grid, separators, borders, labels or text. Flat uniform chroma green background RGB(0,255,0), no gradient, no floor shadow, no green on the subject, no lettering, borders, watermark, props outside the silhouette or detached debris. All clothing, shoes, soles, skin and accessories are fully opaque in their specified non-green colors: NO green apparel, green footwear, green reflections or translucent green body parts. Chroma green belongs only outside the character. Leave ample clear green padding around the whole subject. Use a solid clean ink silhouette, without a colored outline fringe. Accessories remain attached to the character; exactly one of each visible accessory.
Create the requested original game art. Follow the layout and reference identity precisely.

# combat_effects

CLOUD ONLY. This graph contains 1 paid image-generation node(s). Running those nodes consumes Comfy credits. Source Load Image and Save nodes are local file operations. No generation is triggered by creating or building these files.

Source photos feed anime model references; those outputs feed all derived art for consistent identity.

Outputs: ComfyUI/output/hackathon/. Import with npm run import:assets -- --from <output-folder>, then npm run build. Inspect pose sheets and anchors before release. Do not put credentials in this workflow.
